qa.complaint_resolution_evidence: At 390x844 viewport, document.scrollWidth === clientWidth === 390 (no page horizontal scroll). The new useMessageContentMaxWidth hook returns 390px on the 390 viewport (visible as `max-width: 390px` on messageContent's depth-3 inner div). userMessageBubble width measured at 380, right=380, withinViewport=true. Bash tool inline command card has width=364, right=372 with internal scrollable div (scrollWidth=1390, overflowX=auto) so the long command scrolls INSIDE the card, not past viewport. Hook reactivity smoke-test: resize 1440->800->390 produced maxWidth values 800px->800px->390px without page reload (AC4).
